title: Contracts
subtitle: Manage unit contracts and payment schedules
linesEmptyHint: Start with a rental unit or a service fee.
contractNotDraft: Only draft contracts can be edited here
createPageSubtitle: Build lines, save a draft, or activate billing.
editPageSubtitle: Update contract details and save changes.
scheduleLockedHint: Invoice schedule fields are locked because invoices were issued or payments were recorded.
unitsLockedHint: Units on an active contract cannot be changed here.
annualPricingHint: Enter the annual amount before tax for each line. The system derives the full contract total, VAT, and every installment from the dates and payment cycle.
legacyPricingBanner: This contract uses the previous full-contract total entry. New contracts use annual amounts before tax.
legacyLineAmountHint: Full contract total including tax for this line
serviceProductsLoadFailed: Could not load service products. Check the Odoo service category setting.
serviceProductInvalid: The selected service product is unavailable or outside the configured Odoo service category.
rentIncreaseHint: The increase applies to rental installments after the selected years. For annual pricing it changes the derived contract total.
rentIncreaseSummary: After {years} years, rental installments are {percentage}% higher.
contractPdfHint: PDF only, up to 10 MB. The file is stored privately.
pdfUploadFailed: The contract was saved, but the PDF upload failed. Try the upload again.
pdfSizeInvalid: PDF must be 10 MB or smaller.
pdfPreviewEmpty: Upload the signed contract to preview it here.
contractSavedPdfRetry: The contract was saved. Retry the PDF upload before closing.
pdfDownloadFailed: Could not open the contract PDF.
noContractDocumentHint: Upload a signed PDF from the contract form to preview it here.
draftScheduleHint: Preview based on the current draft. These invoices will be created when the contract is activated.
odooPartnerRequired: Select an Odoo customer to link this contract
syncTenantToOdoo: Create or match this tenant in Odoo when saving
activeContractExists: This unit already has an active contract
cancellationDateOutOfRange: Cancellation date must be within the contract period
cancellationHasIssuedInvoices: The contract has issued, synced, or paid invoices affected by this cancellation. Settle them with a credit note or refund before cancelling.
cancellationRequiresSettlement: The amount already paid exceeds the prorated amount. Record the required refund or credit note before cancelling.
contractCancellationFailed: The contract could not be cancelled. No cancellation changes were saved; try again.
contractHasFinancialActivity: Cannot change contract terms after invoices have been issued or payments recorded
validationFailed: Contract could not be saved. Check the entered data and try again.
contractCreateFailed: The contract could not be saved due to an internal error. No data was saved; try again.
openingBalanceHint: For existing contracts: enter the end date of the last fully paid installment, and any partial amount already paid on the first open installment. Older installments stay local and are not linked to Odoo.
odooTrackingHint: Odoo matching starts from the first unpaid installment onward.
odooTrackingStartPreview: First open installment for Odoo tracking: {start} → {end}

validation.nationalIdInvalid: Enter a valid Saudi National ID / Iqama
validation.startDateInvalid: Start date must be a valid date between 1990 and 2100
validation.endDateInvalid: End date must be a valid date between 1990 and 2100
validation.endBeforeStart: End date must be on or after start date
validation.amountPositive: Contract value must be greater than zero
validation.paidThroughInvalid: Paid through date must be a valid date between 1990 and 2100
validation.paidThroughOutOfRange: Paid through date must be within the contract period
validation.openingPaidNegative: Opening paid amount cannot be negative
validation.openingPaidExceedsPeriod: Opening paid amount cannot exceed the first unpaid period amount
validation.tooManyPeriods: This contract would create more than 50 invoices. Shorten the period or choose a longer payment cycle.
validation.scheduleFailed: Cannot build the invoice schedule with these values
validation.linesRequired: Add at least one contract line
validation.rentalLineRequired: Add at least one rental unit line
validation.duplicateUnits: The same unit cannot appear twice
validation.lineAmountPositive: Each line amount must be greater than zero
validation.serviceProductRequired: Select an Odoo product for every service line
validation.taxRateInvalid: VAT rate must be between 0 and 100
validation.lastPaymentInvalid: Last payment date must be a valid date
validation.lastPaymentOutOfRange: Last payment date must be within the contract period
validation.historicalLastPaymentNegative: Last historical payment amount cannot be negative
validation.conditionAfterYearsInvalid: Years must be a whole number from 1 to 100
validation.conditionAfterContractEnd: The increase must start before the contract ends
validation.conditionPercentageInvalid: Increase percentage must be greater than zero and no more than 1000%
